test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order forming a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Gopu was not allowed into the main temple shrine.

B. But Gopu did not mind his work.

C. Pandit Ji had given him a little room in the courtyard of the temple and this was the only place he could call his own.

D. He would sit every evening outside the temple to look after the shoes and slippers of the devotees.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'ADBC'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Statement A will come first as it contains the subject i.e.** 'Gopu' **and the context of the paragraph.
 
• Statement D will follow statement A as it connects with statement A with the help of the pronoun 'he'.
 
• Statement B will follow statement D as it mentions that Gopu didn't mind the work he was doing in statement D.
 
• Statement C will come last.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

The final sequence will be: 

 
• A: Gopu was not allowed into the main temple shrine.
 
• D: He would sit every evening outside the temple to look after the shoes and slippers of the devotees.
 
• B: But Gopu did not mind his work.
 
• C: He would sit every evening outside the temple to look after the shoes and slippers of the devotees.
